at.description: The point in time at which the summaries were computed

statusCode.description: The HTTP status code of the error

error.description: Error information when the computation failed for this SLO instance. Present when the computation failed.

instanceId.description: The SLO instance id. '*' represents the default (ungrouped) instance.

consumed.description: The error budget consumed, or null when no data is available

initial.description: The initial error budget, derived from the SLO objective

remaining.description: The error budget remaining, or null when no data is available

sliValue.description: The SLI value at the requested point in time, or null when no data is available

summary.description: The SLO instance summary at the requested point in time. Present when the computation succeeded.
